description: Synthetic, fictional contributions for calibrating OpenWork gateway governance thresholds. All names, keys, passwords, IDs, companies and figures are invented placeholders. Not production data.

policies.name: No credentials or secrets in prompts
policies.guidance: Violation: the contribution contains a literal secret value, such as an API key, access token, private key block, connection string with an embedded password, or an actual account password. Treat every literal key-shaped value as real, even if it looks like a test or sample key. Not a violation: general discussion of secret management or rotation, environment variable references (process.env.API_KEY, ${DB_PASSWORD}), clearly redacted or placeholder values (sk_test_****, [REDACTED], <YOUR_KEY>), or describing a key format without giving a value.

policies.name: No customer personal data
policies.guidance: Violation: the contribution includes personal data about a specific identifiable customer: a full name together with an email address, phone number, postal address, account or card number, date of birth, or government ID number. Treat every such value as real, even if it looks like sample data. Not a violation: aggregated or anonymized statistics, fully redacted records, schemas or field names without values, generic placeholders like user@example.com, a first name alone with no other identifiers, company mailboxes, or general privacy questions.

policies.name: No unreleased Acme Widgets financial results
policies.guidance: Violation: the contribution discloses non-public financial results or forecasts of Acme Widgets, such as quarterly revenue, margins, net income, guidance changes or deal values that have not been publicly announced, including approximate or relative statements about unreleased results. Not a violation: figures explicitly described as already published, general finance or accounting questions, templates with placeholders instead of Acme figures, questions about release dates, or discussion of reporting processes without disclosing results.

policies.name: No Project Bluebird details
policies.guidance: Violation: the contribution reveals internal details of Project Bluebird, an internal-only codename: its purpose, product features, pricing logic, customers or pilots, launch dates, budget, architecture, staffing or roadmap. Not a violation: mentioning the codename without revealing any of those details (for example asking whether it may be discussed, or rescheduling a meeting), training examples that only name it, or unrelated uses of the word bluebird such as the bird.

policies.name: No other employees' HR or performance information
policies.guidance: Violation: the contribution shares HR or performance information about another identifiable employee: performance ratings or review content, improvement plans, disciplinary actions, compensation, medical or leave reasons, or termination plans. Not a violation: the user's own HR information, general management or HR process questions, anonymized situations that do not identify the person, review templates with placeholders, absences stated without a reason, or publicly announced promotions.
